articleTitle: Calculation of average time for path setting in integrated service digital networks
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design procedure of time for path setting in integrated service digital networks (ISDN) is offered. Influence of load intensity change on qualitative characteristics ISDN is analyzed.

articleTitle: Microwave autodyne moving sensors for measurement of burning speed of high-energy composite materials
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Speed of burning is the basic characteristic of high-energy composite materials (HECM), and it is usually determined by results of the analysis of pressure dependence on time in stationary experiences on small samples burning at several relatively constant pressure within the limits of 10%. In materials of present report radar-tracking autodyne devices in a frequency range from 30.0 up to 10.0 GHz are submitted which have been developed for measurement of the current burning speed of fuels samples in the non-stationary conditions caused pressure or HECM quality changes on thickness of a sample burning arch. Methodical problems of processing of the measuring information are considered. Operational opportunities of autodyne moving sensors for a wide range of change of measurements conditions and for tested materials properties are determined. The attenuation dependence of electromagnetic microwave radiation on the contents of the fine-dyspersated aluminium in HECM structure is established. In the given results of experimental researches an applicability of the microwave method realized with use of autodyne sensors for an estimation of HECM quality and definition of the burning law is shown at measurements of burning speed in conditions of growing pressure that opens an opportunity of forecasting of burning HECM laws in various devices

articleTitle: Dynamic chaos in phase synchronization devices
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Phase portrait evolution of phase synchronization device with 3/sup rd/-order low-frequency filter were studied using self-organization methodology, revealing complex dynamics of ordered and chaotic states depending on device parameters.

articleTitle: Dielectric permeability measurements with waveguide Bragg structure usage
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Usage of waveguide 1D Bragg structures allows proposing the method of the dielectric permeability measurements in 8-mm range of wavelength. Method is based on the phase-sensitive properties of a transmission peak in the band gap of waveguide distributed Bragg structure in K-band

articleTitle: Near-field microwave tomography
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the method for reconstruction of 3D parameters structure (temperature, permittivity) of absorbent half-space using the data of passive/active near-field microwave scanning over its surface is presented. The method possibilities are demonstrated on the example of reconstruction of permittivity structure of human tissues

articleTitle: Concept of integrated environment for network design
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This work examines CANDy and NDML concepts. CANDy, Computer Aided Network Design utility is a concept for an efficient XML-based integrated network design environment. Its integrating components are NDML (Network Design Markup Language), an XML-based problem-oriented language developed for representation of information components related to network projecting within documents. Its design supports interoperability with the XML family of tools and protocols. It provides a set of components to meet the needs of network design

articleTitle: Near field of non-resonant system of transverse slots in rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the research of electromagnetic waves radiation by system of non-resonant transverse slots in the broad wall of rectangular waveguide. Such slot structure is the kind of leaky-wave antenna. The investigation of the spatial near field distribution of the system was carried out.

articleTitle: Service-oriented architectures: potential and challenges
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper gives an overview of the service-oriented approach, focusing on its general strategic issues as well as on its technical foundations using Web services. Based on example scenarios, the overall potential of this emerging technology is outlined with respect to open systems integration, dynamic binding, and flexible management of distributed systems.

articleTitle: Design particularities for wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Particularities of design for innovative wireless networks-WLAN and WiMAX-are examined. Models and methods for wireless networks design are investigated. Main requirements as well as integration way into a XML-based network design environment is shown.

articleTitle: 71-76 GHz wireless bridge for Ethernet networks
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Mm-wave wireless bridges are the good alternative to lower frequency microwave and optical infrared system. But mm-wave systems available are rather expansive. Low cost 71-76 GHz wireless bridge DTS-10FD for Ethernet (IEEE 802.3) networks was developed. Its operation range is up to 2 km. DTS-10FD includes integrated mm-wave transceiver with orthomode transducer (OMT), monolithic GaAs mixer and modulator circuits. It requires no tuning and is suitable for mass production. Lightweight and low cost Fresnel zone plate antenna for DTS-10FD was developed. Production of DTS-10FD was started and development of 100 Mbit/s systems is in progress.

articleTitle: Dielectric properties of glucose solutions in the millimeter-wave range and a problem of glucose content in blood control
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The objective of this paper is to investigate the dielectric properties of epsiv for glucose solutions in water, an imitator of blood, for blood, and for skin using new nondestructive method as well as to investigate the possibility of using millimeter waves for sugar (glucose) concentration control in human blood, including non-invasive control

articleTitle: Using of the millimeter wave dielectrometer for study of liquid helium dynamic characteristics
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The WGM method was used in designed cryogenic dielectrometer for measurement of dielectric parameters of cryogenic liquids with small losses within the frequency range of 50-150 GHz and temperatures 0.8-300 K. The change of resonant characteristics of high-Q DDR, placed into He <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> at temperature lower the lambda-transition (a superfluid state) is detected

articleTitle: On the increase of the frequency band of cyclotron protective device
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of experimental investigation for widening frequency band of cyclotron protective devices with 4-5% to 8-10% in 3-cm wavelength range are presented.

articleTitle: Resonant properties of double-wire suspended stripline resonator
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A double-wire stripline resonator on a suspended dielectric substrate is a novel resonant structure, which can be used in miniature microwave filters. The resonator differs in both short length and high Q factor. Resonant frequencies are investigated in this paper. It is proved that the length of a regular double-wire suspended stripline resonator is shorter than a quarter of wavelength

articleTitle: Simulation of an ultra-wideband antenna for step-frequency ground penetrating radar using method of moments
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of simulation of ultra-wideband antennas for step-frequency ground penetrating radar (GPR) using IE3D software realizing method of moments. Features of planar antenna currents distribution, influencing on radiations parameters are discussed. Ways of improvement of antenna characteristics accounting for the features of the antenna utilization are proposed. The simulation data for planar tapered slot antennas (TSA) covering frequency range as wide as 11:1 are given. The antenna VSWR does not exceed 2 almost in the full frequency band, whereas the antenna gain is of 6-8.5 dBi.

articleTitle: Composite diamond-AIN dielectric substrates for heatsink materials
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Polycrystalline diamond films on dielectric AIN ceramic substrates have been produced by microwave plasma CVD process using CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>/H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> reaction gas mixtures. Thermal conductivity of diamond layer, AIN single crystal and AIN ceramics are 1000, 300 and 200 W/cmK, respectively, as measured using laser flash technique. Thus the thermal conductivity of the top layer of AIN heat spreaders can be significantly improved using diamond overcoat

articleTitle: Strip-line filter with suspended substrate
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Diminutive band-pass filter operating in meter and decimeter bands is described. Its original design and suspended substrate provide higher Q-factor of filter resonators than for microstrip ones. The filter itself has good selectivity and small transmission loss. Numerical analysis of filter design carried out under quasi-TEM assumption well agrees with the experiment.

articleTitle: The local oscillator for VLBI "radioastron" project receiver
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: LO for VLBI receiver at the frequency band 18-25 GHz for "radioastron" project has been developed. The main objective of the work was minimization of LO phase fluctuation with respect to reference oscillator signal. LO phase error about 1 degree RMS was simulated and measured.

articleTitle: X-band MMIC limiter
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents results of design of X-band MMIC high speed limiter. These limiters have a small size and technological compatibility with MMIC amplifiers. The experimental characteristics are given.

articleTitle: Impedance of magnetostatic surface wave coplanar transducer
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A technique is described for computing the radiation impedance (both the reactance and radiation resistance) per unit length of coplanar-waveguide (CPW). The dependence of this impedance on the spacing between the coplanar transducer and ferrite plate (FP) is determined for the case of magnetostatic surface waves

articleTitle: The broadband antenna with controlled polarization of radiation
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The broadband aerial with operated polarization of a radiation field on the basis of a four-way conic spiral is considered. The principle of construction of the antenna is described and results of numerical simulation and experimental researches are presented.

articleTitle: Expert system FILTEX32 for computer-aided design of bandpass microstrip filters
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The expert system automatically determines conductor pattern for microstrip filters (MSF) with fractional bandwidth falling in the interval 2...100 % in the frequency range 0.02...20 GHz. The system includes extensive, permanently replenishing library of studied structures, is simple in operation, has a convenient dialogue interface, and is supplied with a help system

articleTitle: DC - 4 GHz GaAs MMIC variable attenuator
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: DC to 4 GHz broadband microwave monolithic variable attenuator with dimensions 0.7/spl times/0.9/spl times/0.125 mm/sup 3/ has been developed. VSWR better than 1.3, 1.0-2.5 dB insertion loss and 1.5 dB bandpass flatness have been achieved.

articleTitle: Frequency tuning of Gunn diode self-oscillator stabilized by quasi-optical dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The capability of mechanical frequency tuning of Gunn diode self-oscillator by the both metal and dielectric pin inserted into the partially shielded quasi-optical dielectric resonator is considered. The resonator's eigen frequencies obtained theoretically and experimentally are compared with oscillation frequencies

publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The represented project is similar to the projects made and well-known in technical literature abroad in the 80-90s of the former century.

articleTitle: Gunn oscillator on the base of barrel-shaped dielectric resonator for the measurement of liquids' dielectric properties
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown that the high Q-factor value of a dielectric resonator as the dielectrometer base causes the high sensitivity of the measurement of liquid dielectric properties. This resonator allows improving the measurements and classification of a broad class of liquids, including having high value of loss tangent.

articleTitle: The study of chaotic algorithm characteristics using fractal analysis methods
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The investigation methods of chaotic algorithm characteristics on the basis of fractal analysis has been proposed.

articleTitle: A method of synthesis loaded coupled-line fixed phase shifters
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method for synthesis of electrical parameters of coupled-line fixed phase shifters is proposed. The desired value of transmission phase change and input matching are provided by using the additional reactance simultaneously with discontinuities effect compensation

articleTitle: Diffraction radiation oscillator with resonant groove on the mirror
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental results of diffraction radiation oscillator investigation in the 5-mm wave range are presented. In order to improve the DRO output characteristics the step resonant obstacle as a groove on the OR mirror is applied. The DRO frequency tuning range was 42-64 GHz under the output level up to 5 Watt.

articleTitle: Analysis of the electromagnetic field structure illuminating the aperture of phased-array antennas from far field distance
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimentally measured results on electromagnetic field structure illuminating phased antenna array (PAA) aperture from far field distance are presented. Analysis of electromagnetic field structure is performed and limitations of measuring and control methods using reference signal source at far field distance are considered.

articleTitle: Modification of complex conditional optimization method by box for definition of slow wave structure sizes using given electrodynamic characteristics
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of development of an effective search method of a global extremum for the decision of a problem of definition of the slow wave structure sizes such as a coupled cavity chain on the given electrodynamic characteristics or equivalent parameters are presented. Results of definition the slow wave structure sizes on given dispersion and interaction impedance are adduced

articleTitle: Influence of powerful pulse electromagnetic fields on household devices
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of experimental researches concerning influence of pulse electromagnetic fields upon household electronic devices are analyzed. Researches were carried out on a basis of electronic clocks, calculators, and mobile phones

articleTitle: New approaches to the data-processing resources development on the basis of EJB
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article deals with the concept of integrated environment for designing, programming and testing of complex software system. The presented environment based on Web-services and S212 designing principles. It let the possibility to intensify programming process at the expense use of software environment for integrated interaction of designing processes on all software life cycle stages.

articleTitle: Computer-aided design of ultrawide-band MMIC amplifier
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design of 2-10 GHz feedback MMIC amplifier is presented using a new interactive "visual" technique. The existing design procedures for microwave amplifiers with compensation/feedback networks are cumbersome and time-consuming. In this paper, we demonstrate the design of single-stage ultrawide-band feedback MMIC amplifier using a new interactive "visual" technique. The technique allows the exact synthesis of compensation/feedback networks directly from a simultaneous set of performance specifications, including the gain, gain flatness, noise figure, input/output matching, and stability. The procedure is implemented in our "visual" CAD tools, AMP-CF and LOCUS, providing the fast and convenient amplifier design. With these tools, we have designed and fabricated a 2-10 GHz feedback MMIC amplifier that can be served as an amplifier block for different applications. Amplifier has been implemented in 0.2 mum pHEMT GaAs technology (OMMIC, France), providing gain 11.7plusmn1.1 dB, noise figure 2.2 dB, input and output return losses -9.6 dB and -11 .7 dB, respectively

articleTitle: MM-wave all-aspect radiometric sensor
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of design and experimental investigation of radiometric sensor for shortwave part of mm-band, which is the basic information unit of passive monitoring system

articleTitle: Characteristics of microwave detectors with low barrier planar Schottky diodes
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design principles and technology of fabricating sensitive microwave detectors on the basis of low barrier (0.2-0.3 eV) Schottky diodes are developed. A family of diodes and diode-based broadband detectors featuring 1000-5000 V/W sensitivity and 10/sup -11/ W Hz/sup -1/2/ threshold power at millimeter wavelengths and zero-bias operation are fabricated.

articleTitle: Estimation of dielectric characteristics of absorbing medium on frequency and electronic tuning steepness of self-excited oscillator on the basis of Gunn-effect diode, stabilized by quasi-optical dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Dependences of frequency modification and electronic tuning steepness of self-excited oscillator on basis of Gunn-effect diode is stabilized of partially shielded quasi-optical dielectric resonator on binary aqueous solutions concentration of acetone and ethyl alcohol are obtained. The relationships for the dielectric characteristics of absorbing medium estimation in the geometro-optical approach are obtained

articleTitle: Device control measurement and checking methods and algorithms
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: There were developed some parameters measurement and radio-electronic device data processing algorithms using modern measurement instrumentation and special software support. There was given analog device parameters control and measurement algorithm and examples

articleTitle: The magnetic controlled autogenerator superhigh frequencies
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Investigations of superhigh-frequency oscillator are presented on the basis of transistor structure consisting of bipolar and HEMT of transistors. The possibility of both magnetic and electric frequency control of generation is shown

articleTitle: Status of the 70 meter antenna in Yevpatoria
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Information is given about status of the 70 m antenna in Yevpatoria (Ukraine) with recent results. A new S-X band receiver front-end has been installed made by 'Saturn' in Kiev. Apart from the transmitting equipments (P-band and C- band) and older receiving equipments, new radio astronomy receiver front-ends have been recently installed. This paper reports about antenna status, addressing some critical antenna parameters. Tests have been carried out in different frequency bands. Reception of signals from Mars Express and Rosetta was done. A radio science receiver configuration with real time Fourier transformation has been used to inspect spectra and assess frequency, without demodulation. Indications are given for future activities. Non-technical aspects are indicated as well: progress depends not always on instrumentation, radio-physical or electro-mechanical knowledge and related parameter settings

articleTitle: Figure of merit of microwave filters
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Microwave filters are characterized by a lot of parameters, which are related to each other in such a way that parameter improvement leads to deterioration of another one. An integral criterion is therefore needed in order to characterize efficiency of filter design. A figure of merit of microwave filters is introduced in order to compare different designs of integral filters by means of their frequency response and occupied area

articleTitle: The synergetic aspects in medical applications of electromagnetic microwaves
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The device and the method for human organism physiocorrection on the base of simultaneous using of the low-intensive electromagnetic fields and magnetic fields with the special energy-frequency and polarization (vector-frequency) characteristics are developed.

articleTitle: Radiowave interferometry of human thorax displacement, related with breath and heartbeats
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the application of fixed-frequency and multifrequency radiowave interferometry using magic tee and Gunn-diode autodyne for detection of human respiratory shifts and heartbeats is presented. The methods, which provide remote detection of thorax shifts, caused by respiratory movements and heartbeats, are implemented; amplitudes and frequencies of respiratory movements and heartbeats are measured

articleTitle: Measure of non-standard systems of Z- and S-parameters for microwave two-ports
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Measuring method of non-standard systems of Z- and S-parameters for microwave two-ports by measuring of complex reflection coefficients from input (output) of two-port with arbitrary loads is considered

articleTitle: Hybrid method for analysis of slot antennas placed on convex surfaces
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A hybridization technique of finite-element method (FEM) and geometrical theory of diffraction (GTD) is presented. It is intended for analysis of slot antennas installed on convex impedance surfaces.

articleTitle: Scattering of microwave packets on dielectric filters
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper is the solution of a problem of modulated EM pulses scattering on dielectric filters-systems of coupled high-Q dielectric resonators, which are located in segments of below-cutoff waveguides or regular lines. Common analytical results for Green functions in time domain for bandpass and bandstop filters have been obtained. For the first time transient scattering processes of short modulated rectangular pulses in microwave dielectric filters have been investigated subject to actual influence of their frequency response functions

articleTitle: Power and frequency characteristics of Gunn-diodes on the basis of GaN
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of researches of power and frequency characteristics for Gunn-diode on the basis of GaN with different active length with dipole domain and accumulation layers is presented. It is possible to obtain generation using such diodes in submillimeter range.

articleTitle: Automobile continuous millimeter radar
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design of automobile continuous radar system is considered. This system uses 2 types of modulation (linear frequency modulation and M-sequence phase manipulation) simultaneously that allows to increase system quality. It allows to obtain angle accuracy 1deg in angle range 12deg, and distance accuracy 0,2 in 150 m range

articleTitle: Tunable delay line on quadrature bridge with digitally controlled group delay characteristic
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Tunable delay line (TDL) based on the quadrature directional coupler is proposed. Calculated and measurement characteristics of the delay line with digitally variable group delay characteristic by pin-diodes are given

articleTitle: Low-noise extra-low-power amplifiers for future radio astronomy receivers
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new approach to design of low-noise amplifiers with extremely low power consumption is given. The power consumption of 50 microwatt per stage with 10-dB-gain over L-band has been obtained at room temperature.

articleTitle: Resonant tunneling structure simulation using one- and two-band combined models
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of resonant tunneling structures simulation using developed combined one- and two-band models are presented. Comparison between results has demonstrated that the deviation is not too large for particular case

articleTitle: Electrodynamic characteristics of open wave-guide with the diffraction-connected sources of radiation
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the experimental investigation on electrodynamic system of open wave-guide with diffraction-connected sources of radiation. Perspectivity of such system for creation of element base and amplifiers of millimeter wavelengths is shown.

articleTitle: Native stations of the corporate satellite communications networks
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In operation the features of performance and direction of solution of basic problems originating at designing of small corporate satellite telecommunication networks are explained. In particular, the basic performances and parameters of the similar network are defined; the tasks emerging during choice of a method of a multiple access and the technology of slot commutation in a small corporate satellite transmission network are explained the directions of research and efficiency testing of the network with use of methods simulation technique are contoured.

articleTitle: Near-field microwave resonant diagnostics of biological tissues
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes about the method for non-invasive diagnostics of pathological changes in biological tissues. The method is based on studying of measuring system resonance characteristics, depending on the probe parameters and its position relative to investigated biological object

articleTitle: Two-stream free electron laser as a source of electromagnetic femto-second wave packages
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A possibility to design the powerful source of femto-second wave packages (FWP) is analyzed. Characteristic feature of the system considered is the use of peculiar method of compression of wave packages within the interaction MTSFEL volume. It is shown that especially short packages (unites-tens femto-second) can be obtained provided the frequency of the first harmonic space charge wave (SCW) is much less than the optimal frequency of two-stream instability

articleTitle: Combined monopulse airborne phased-array antenna based on a radial waveguide
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Different construction schemes of airborne phased-array antennas (PAA) based on radial waveguides in the X- and K- bands are presented. Several different radiator element constructions are described.

articleTitle: Investigation of electrodynamic properties of surface magnetoplasma waves on the contact of two semiconductor superlattices
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Magnetoplasma waves existing along the con tact of two periodic semiconductor superlattices, placed into external magnetic field, have been researched. It is assumed that the vector of magnetic field is situated in the plane of structure layers, and the waves propagate in the perpendicular plane. It was shown, that three types of surface waves, differing by the phase properties exist. The dispersion dependencies for the surface waves are investigated

articleTitle: CAD tools for "visual" design of microwave transistor amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: CAD tools AMP-CF and REGION are presented for designing microwave transistor amplifiers considering a set of performances. The use of a new "visual" approach leads to increasing design efficiency.

articleTitle: Broadband differential transformers for ICs in LTCC
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper we present constructions of integrated transformers for differential circuits, which were designed for implementation in LTCC technology. Layouts and characteristics of transformers are presented. Designed transformers do not require the ferrite tape

articleTitle: A 20 GHz compact scalable model of silicon-based on-chip spiral inductor for RFICS
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, a new scalable compact high-frequency Si-based on-chip spiral inductor model is presented that consists of a new substrate network and underpass oxide leakage component to model the reduction in equivalent series resistance at higher frequencies. The model accurately estimates the equivalent circuit parameters over a wide frequency range. The proposed model has been verified with the measured results of octagonal spiral inductors fabricated on a six-metal BiCMOS7 process. The model gives excellent fit when compared with the measured data within 10% across different inductor geometries over the frequency range up to 20 GHz. An evolutionary-based particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used for the extraction of model parameters that speeds up the convergence and overcomes the sub-optimal solution of conventional optimization algorithm by fitting Y-parameter, inductance and Q values simultaneously

articleTitle: The method for analysis of multibarrel klystron output circuit
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Solution of the output circuit problem of multibarrel klystron is obtained.

articleTitle: Effect of solution nature on properties of flexible microwave absorbers
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents microwave properties of flexible electromagnetic shields based on solution-containing knitted linens

articleTitle: Improvements in the design of distributed amplifiers using filter theory
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A novel and simple approach for the design of distributed amplifiers is presented. The method is based on fitting the parameters of distributed amplifier to those of predesigned low pass filter. Analytical expressions are derived to show the performance of the new distributed amplifier structure. It is shown that using this method, characteristics of the distributed amplifiers can be improved. Using the proposed method a few distributed amplifiers are designed and excellent agreements between the analytical and simulated results are obtained

articleTitle: Autodyne mini-radars of the millimeter range
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the given message results of autodyne structure of the MM transceiver with various kinds of modulation are submitted and devices for processing of the accepted signals are considered. The most preferable active element for autodyne radar are Gunn diodes surpassing other types of active elements under the basic power characteristics, and also under electric durability, reliability, stability and do not demand high values of supply voltage. In a short-wave part of a MM range InP Gunn diodes have considerably best parameters, than GaAs devices, and development of devices with the highly effective oscillator on low-current Gunn diodes can provide excellent mini-radar characteristics

articleTitle: Submm-range 1 W power TWT project
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The project of compact multibeam submillimeter-range TWT is presented. Main problems and advantages of multibeam TWT design are discussed.

articleTitle: New technological possibilities for formation of GaAs and InP epitaxial layers for Gunn diodes
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We consider a novel technological approach to formation of structurally-perfect indium-phosphide and gallium-arsenide epitaxial n-layers grown on specially prepared porous n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-InP and n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaAs substrates. The structural properties of epitaxial layers and output parameters of the Gunn diodes made on their basis were studied. The InP and GaAs epitaxial layers were grown in the same conditions on the standard substrates. The advantages of the epitaxial layers grown on porous substrates and Gunn diodes made on their basis are demonstrated

articleTitle: 3D simulation of magnetrons with secondary-emission cathode stimulated by electrons from a field emitter
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of 3-D simulation of the secondary-electro multiplication process in a magnetron with cold secondary emission Pd-Ba alloy cathode in which the primary electron sources are the blade-shaped field emitters. The application of the anode voltage pulse tandem is conducive to improving the efficiency and reliability of triggering the electromagnetic self-oscillation excitation in magnetron oscillator, as the nanosecond radiation pulses are generated.

articleTitle: The tasks of biophysics after revealing of the nature of life
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this report the author consider the core of physics of the alive: an idea that all living objects form fourth steps of quantum ladder of nature. It means that the stable variety of animate nature is akin to diverse differential stability of the world on nuclear, atomic and molecular levels.

articleTitle: Optimization of relativistic TWT and BWO on a basis of the two-dimensional theory
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in the paper is two-dimensional theory of relativistic TWT-BWO taking into account cut-off modes. Numerical realization of the theory is based on application of a special method of block matrix prorace for decision of a point-to-point boundary problem for ODE of amplitudes of the connected waves. Optimum variants of the relativistic generator are found and investigated. Attention is paid to absence of conditions of periodicity of the second type (Flocke conditions) in a field of the matched section of periodic irregular waveguide.

articleTitle: Dehydration of the alkaline metal iodide in microwave
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Dehydration of the alkaline metal iodide in vacuum microwave drying are studied. It is shown that dehydration of the salts under the action of microwave is caused more quickly in contrast with traditional thermal heating

articleTitle: Development of communication facilities and radio detection in the naval forces of Russia and USSR during 1900-1945 (to the 110-th anniversary of radio invention)
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper reviews the development of communication facilities and radio detection the naval forces of Russia and USSR during 1900-1945

articleTitle: Low power consumption mm-band GaAs oscillators
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: GaAs Gunn diodes based oscillators providing low power consumption levels of 10...30 mW, useful microwave power of 0.1...0.3 mW and a 1...2% efficiency across the 65...75 GHz frequency range have been experimentally investigated.

articleTitle: Multifrequency antenna system for orthogonal polarization signals reception
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is design of antenna device for orthogonal polarization signals reception within 4-18 GHz band.

articleTitle: Chaotic synchronization of two backward wave oscillators with a transverse field and distributed input of signal
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Oscillations chaotic synchronization in two coupled backward wave oscillators (BWO) with transverse field and distributed signal input has been studied. Chaotic synchronization of distribution systems have been analyzed using wavelet transform. The physical processes which are responsible for the transition from asynchronous oscillations to chaotic synchronization regime have also been considered

articleTitle: Influence of the external signal upon the dynamics of the electron beam in diode space with breaking voltage
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are experimental and computational investigation of dynamics of electron beam with virtual cathode in diode space with breaking voltage. System dynamics control using microwave velocity modulation of the electron beam is discussed. Different complex regimes depending on the value of breaking voltage and control signal parameters are observed

articleTitle: Excitation of a finite chain of coupled cavities filled with a piecewise homogeneous magnetodielectric medium
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Forced oscillations in a finite number of serially located orthogonal T-shaped branchings in rectangular waveguides with magnetodielectric resonators have been studied. Analytical expressions for highly accurate engineering calculations of resonant frequencies have been obtained. Classification of waveguide-dielectric resonances of basic elements has been conducted. A possibility of using this structure for narrow-band and broadband microwave filters is shown.

articleTitle: Millimeter wave HEMTs of R&PC /spl Lt/Istok/spl Gt/
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: First results of heterostructure field effect transistors with 120, 300 and 600 /spl mu/m gate widths developed in R&PC /spl Lt/Istok/spl Gt/ are presented. Pseudo-morphic high electron mobility epitaxial structure were grown by molecular beam epitaxy. Typical channel carrier concentration 2.0 10/sup 12/ cm/sup -2/ with mobilities > 6000 cm/sup 2//V-s were obtained at 300 K. The transistors were fabricated with 0,15-0,25 /spl mu/m T-gate. The devises demonstrates minimum noise figure less than 2 dB, associated gain more than 5 dB at 40 GHz, and output power density about 900 mW/mm at centimeter wave-length band with power added efficiency more then 30%.

articleTitle: The system of movement control of magnetically levitative vehicle on a base of synchronized microwave generators
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Conception of construction of the informative-control navigation system of the high-speed ground vehicle on the basis of method of measuring of phase correlations between the mobile and immobile signals of the high-sensitive microwave generators is represented

articleTitle: New avalanche breakdown model for nonuniform electric fields
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown that correct avalanche breakdown voltages for submicron MESFETs and especially for HEMTs can be obtained only if we substitute the phenomenological avalanche coefficients dependencies on electric field magnitude with the similar dependencies of these coefficients on the mean energies of electron and hole gases. The same substitution for other kinetic coefficients is usual in so called temperature models used for simulation systems with nonuniform electric fields. Application of new model for MESFET simulation leads to noticeable improvement of measured and simulated breakdown voltages coincidence and in HEMT simulation one can obtain sensible results for current-voltage characteristics only with the help of the new model. The new model success is based on more physically meaningful operation with the great contact electric fields which are common in submicron gate MESFETs and HEMTs

articleTitle: Increasing the efficiency of using Internet protocol in Intranet networks
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main aim of this work is research the abilities of changing Internet protocol's version in networks, which are not connected to the global Internet. The result is sequence of operations for transition from IPv4 to IPv6.

articleTitle: Microwave digital telecommunication systems as programmed radiosystems
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The model of detection and recognition of digital communication systems signals is offered. That model has allowed to prove demands to programmed radiosystems. Practical implementation of such system is carried out in-process using PC-based real-time signal analyzer and state-of-the-art digital signal processor of Texas Instruments manufacture.

articleTitle: Ferroelectric film examination at microwaves
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Various methods of microwave measurement of thin dielectric film with large dielectric permittivity (epsiv~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>) and increased loss (tandelta~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>-1) are compared. Non-contacting and non-destructive investigation waveguide method is recommended. This method does not need electrode deposition onto a film surface, so the natural features of film are obtained

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave two-stage orbotron as an amplifier and frequency multiplier
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the results of CAD and parameters optimization for two-stage amplifier orbotrons of and multipliers of EM oscillations frequency.

articleTitle: Methods for data adequacy improvement in radio-networks with frequency jumping
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper are the methods for data adequacy improvement and data application in 802.11 radio-networks with frequency jumping.

articleTitle: Magnetoacoustic waves in solar atmosphere detected by radio observations
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The observations of variations of solar radio radiation on October 7, 2002 with a large radio telescope RT-22 SRI CrAO at wavelength 2.0, 2.3 and 3.5 cm revealed by a method of the wavelet-analysis a 78-sec delay of oscillations with period of 1760 sec at the longer wavelength of observation. articleTitle: Internet organization in MMDS range
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The equipment and technical decision of DOCSIS Internet signals transmitter receiving are considered. It operates in MMDS and allows creating on air broadcasting net with a number of subscribers up to 1000 and more, and with a radius up to 20-30 km.

articleTitle: 0.01-178.40 GHz wideband spectrum analyzer
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main items of upgrade of the spectrum analyzer intended for research of spectrum harmonic radiosignals in the frequencies range of 0.01-178.4 GHz, covered by 8 external mixers in 13 sub-bands are presented

articleTitle: Selector of reflector antenna feed for all polarizations
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Calculation method of all-polarizations selector of reflector antenna feed using electrodynamics potential method is considered.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamics of multifrequency excitation mode in coaxial slow-wave transmission line
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The study of multifrequency excitation mode of coaxial slow-wave transmission line is carried out. The dynamic of wave harmonic from phase mismatch values of excitation waves is analyzed

articleTitle: Microwave induced interference effects in semiconductor devices under short pulse illumination
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Microwave interference effects in semiconductor devices under short pulse illumination are considered. The dependence of microwave-induced interference signal on microwave pulse duration and radiation frequency is analyzed

articleTitle: Electro-mechanically tunable phase shifter
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Novel microwave phase shifters utilizing microstrip line and microstrip filters are proposed. The fabricated phase shifters, which consist of either microstrip line or microstrip filter with either dielectric or metallic control element can be electro-mechanically adjusted in order to obtain up to 90deg phase-shift angle with sufficiently small insertion loss

articleTitle: About spectra of radio signal fluctuations in the turbulent atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The work is devoted to the numerical analysis of influence of non-uniform and non-stationary processes in troposphere on radio signal spectral characteristics. It is shown, that disregard of these factors may cause significant error in restoration of troposphere parameters

articleTitle: Broadband semiconductor protection devices for 8-mm waveband
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of design of wideband semiconductor switches and limiters for 8-mm waveband on the basis of waveguide-slot line. Operating range of devices designed -26...40 GHz, operating pulse power -100...200 W, continuous (average) operating power -2...3 W. Switchers attenuation - not less than 35 dB, maximum leakage pulse power of the limiter - 20 mW at the most, switchers and limiters operating speed - 100 ns and 300 ns, respectively.

articleTitle: Implementation of Reed-Solomon decoder in MicroBlaze
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Efficiency of implementation of Reed-Solomon decoding algorithm in the synthesized microprocessor kernel MicroBlaze for Xilinx are considered.

articleTitle: Microwave measurements of nanometer metal film on semiconductor substrate
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Method for nondestructive multiparameter check of electrophysical parameters of nanometer metal-semiconductor structures using frequency dependence of the reflection coefficient had been proposed and implemented experimentally

articleTitle: Forming of current instabilities in triple-barrier quantum structures under strong HF electric field
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is found an exact analytical steady-state solution of the self consistent time-dependence Schrodinger and Poisson equations at resonance conditions in asymmetric triple- barrier structures in the electric field of finite amplitude. The solution is defined by three order polynomial equation for uniform electron distribution and five order equations for monoenergetic electron beam. A possible mechanism, which leads to forming of the current instability, is found out. The current oscillation frequency is shown to be function of hf voltage amplitude. Reflection and transmission coefficients and HF conductance are combinations of N and S-type characteristics for uniform electron distribution beams and loop-type characteristic for monoenergetic electron beams

articleTitle: Control of DRO performance using lateral spherical echelette open resonator
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An experimentally verified approach is suggested to execute control over the output power, frequency and signal spectrum of diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO). For this purpose, a lateral spherical echelette open resonator is added to the DRO design.

articleTitle: Study of microwave field structure on water surface paths using radar and moving corner reflector
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the method of determination of vertical coordinate of corner reflector which is based on measurement of Doppler frequency displacement of signals, scattered by the reflector. The method is based on restoration of vertical profile of field structure. Possibility of determination of reflecting points quantity, their coordinates and lifetime on diffusive scattering sea surface using spectral analysis of the signal received are examined

articleTitle: CTV optical equipment
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered here are technical decisions and results of design of group signal optical transmitter with 1 GHz frequencies multiplexing (60 TV channels transmission via fiber optics).

articleTitle: The experimental definition of spectral efficiency for office SRAS
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The outcomes of experimental researches of spectral effectiveness the subscriber radio access systems (SRAS) in the office are presented. The efficiency of a radio link was determined as a ratio of a channel capacity C to a working band B. Ratio C/B frequently name as spectral effectiveness

articleTitle: Comparison of different nonlinear models applied in submicron gate length 5 W transistor of R&PC /spl Lt/ISTOK/spl Gt/
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: For the submicrometer gate field effect transistor developed in R&PC "lstok" yielding 5 W output power in two and three centimeter wave length band, comparison of different nonlinear models, which are common for main system of MIS design has been carried out. It is found that being properly corrected, all models provided satisfactory agreement between calculated and experimental data in spite of apparent limitations peculiar to the models

articleTitle: The analysis of informational properties of speech message source
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main aim of this work is informational model of speech message source investigation that was obtained from "generating" noise, passed through the line circuit.

articleTitle: Nonlinear transmission line on magnetostatic waves
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the proposed paper the features of harmonic signal passing through various types of nonlinear transmission lines on magnetostatic waves are discussed

articleTitle: Broadband power divider-adder
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of investigation of the broadband ribbon-line power divider-adder characteristics are presented. The divider design may have a multi-decade bandwidth. Operation of driver is based on cascade-parallel connection of loads

articleTitle: Slow-wave structures' performances of crossed-field devices
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The most important problem, which represent of practical interest for specialists of UHF electronics and electrodynamics, is the design problem of M-type tubes slow-wave structure with preliminary determined characteristics, determination of limits (field tolerance) for slow-wave structure dimensions and etc. Among perspective solution it can mark branches coupled with creation computer-aided design which provide the operation of design programs to usual users. Now computer-aided design of M-type tubes and their components does not exist. In this connection the problem of the creation of similar systems is actual and is dictated by practical tasks. One of the component part such system: design of slow-wave structure is also shown in the paper.

articleTitle: Simulation of orbotrons-klystrons - generators of millimeter and submillimeter wavebands
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The generators with use of discrete interaction electrons with electromagnetic fields are offered. The mathematical model is formulated, in which the space charge, sagging of fields in the gaps, relativism electrons is taken into account (discounted). It is shown, that the calculation electron efficiency on frequencies 50 and 300 GHz can reach accordingly 66 and 37%.

articleTitle: Efficient transmission of Ethernet channels in microwave radio access systems
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The original method of implementing Ethernet channels in type of "point-to-multipoint" connections for microwave radio access systems is presented. The method is approved in specialized radio-relay system and provides high noise immunity together with enough fast time of channel recovery, optimal ratio of user and service information amounts, easy and low-cost implementing with widespread signal/data processors.

articleTitle: Variations in sedimentation rate of disperse particles in the water irradiated by millimeter waves
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The attenuation of beam of light passing through a suspension-containing cuvette is a convenient tool to measure the sedimentation rate. sedimentation rate. A photosedimentometer based on a KPhiK- 2M type photocolorimeter has been used for this purpose. A decrease in the sedimentation rate of butyral resin superfine solid particles in the water irradiated by mm-waves of 'below-heat' intensity has been discovered. A decrease in the sedimentation rate may be presented as an increase in the effective water viscosity

articleTitle: On reducing complexity of rectangle obstacle minimum number estimation to plan IEEE 802.11a indoor systems by 2D ray-tracing tool
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is a new method for ray tracing acceleration. It is based on decreasing complexity of obstacles minimum number calculation in order to predict the field strength attenuation of vertical polarized OFDM signals of IEEE 802.11a standard. Obstacles distribution is proposed in uniform random.

articleTitle: Automatic calibration device of the vector analyzer in the frequency range 2-8 GHz
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An autocalibration device design is shown. The comparative analysis of measurement results is carried out using traditional and automatic calibrations. Vector network analyzer (VNA) calibration essentially increases the measurement accuracy and is obligatory at work with the device

articleTitle: Microwave transducer of calibrated measuring system of complex transfer constant
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The building method of wideband two-channel four-detector microwave transducer of calibrated measuring system of complex transfer constant of waveguide quadripoles is considered; solution algorithm of gage identities measuring equations is worked out

articleTitle: The realization of intersubject bonds in the process of education of technical universities' students
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article considers some didactic conditions of activation of students' cognitive interest for the educational work in the institute of higher education.

articleTitle: Explosive devices of electromagnetic signal
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper we will review the basic main types of explosive devices, which are offered as generators of oscillations. The results of model operation of these devices are submitted. The features of plasma columns shaped by explosive methods are defined. The results of experimental research of generators with plasma antennas are given
