articleTitle: Microwave noise sources on the basis of electronic multiplier
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented is the possibility of design of micro-wave noise generator by means of electronic beam modulation by low-frequency (against a carrier frequency) noise and regular signal.

articleTitle: Simulation of human body as an object of radiovision
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The aim of the work is to design the model as radar-tracking object. Radar-tracking model of a human body that consists of regular and noise components, is presented and tested. A human body is one of the most interesting objects for radiolocation, radioholography and other vision schemes. There is a need in body simulation that is both simple and realistic. That will allow to simulate radiolocation and radioholography processes and to create comparison template in problems of people recognition in zones of natural calamities. Thus, the hypothesis about an opportunity to form a human body model by regular and noise components has been proved experimentally. The way of such presentation is determined

articleTitle: Condition and prospects of introduction microwave universal multimedia interactive systems of user's access
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The condition of development and introduction of systems of broadcasting radioaccess with use of microwave telecommunication and information technologies is considered. The various variants of a configuration of system MITRIS and its updating UMDS, giving service as finishing up to the subscribers of the programs of a multichannel television announcement, and granting to the subscribers of multimedia services basing interactive access to information resources of system are submitted. It is shown that offered microwave universal multimedia interactive systems provide satisfaction of need of the population of Ukraine in qualitative information services, both in cities, and in village areas, and also development of domestic information technologies: from a soft product up to telecommunication systems. It is marked that the domestic systems MITRIS have the essential intellectual property, are competitive in the world communication market.

articleTitle: Influence of constant and revolving magnetic field on drosophila melanogaster viability
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A constant magnetic field and magnetic fields, revolving clockwise and counterclockwise, cause the significant reduction in drosophila reproductive ability. Most reduction reproductive ability is observed at the influence of revolving magnetic field

articleTitle: Hardware/software system for characterization of microwave electronics materials
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A hardware/software system for characterization of GaAs thin-film structures is described. The system makes it possible to determine the concentration of vacant deep traps at the film-substrate (or film-buffer layer) interface and to predict the MESFET threshold voltage from C-V measurements under infrared illumination

articleTitle: The compact anechoic chamber with a collimation parabolic mirror for researches of microwave antennas
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The optimum distances between the investigated antenna, a collimation mirror, and the collimation mirror irradiator of the compact testing chamber for antennas are determined. The main features of the collimation mirror and the compact testing chamber are presented.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic wave absorbers simulation
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of periodical structure theory and in the framework of solitary cell approximation a simulation of pyramid-like radar absorbing material (RAM) was carried out. The influence of measuring antenna and absorber finite dimensions on the reflection coefficient magnitude was investigated within the frequency band

articleTitle: Nonlinear effects of magnetostatic waves self-influence in layered ferromagnetic structures
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper are the features of nonlinear wave processes and effects of self-influence at excitation of various types of magnetostatic waves in coupled ferromagnetic structures and possibility of nonlinear processes control in ferromagnetic films at coupling variation

articleTitle: Microstrip analogues of band pass filters and mirrors based on photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The constructions of microstrip analogues of band pass filters and mirrors on the base of one-dimensional photonic crystals with abrupt and fuzzy boundaries between the layers are investigated. An opportunity is shown to essentially improve the device's performance

articleTitle: Quasi-optical mm-wave solid-state source having the long-term frequency stability
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A quasi-optical thermo-stabilized Gunn oscillator with long-term frequency stabilization has been proposed.

articleTitle: Automation of processes of vacuum microwave drying the pharmaceutical products
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The basic technological parameters for the control and regulations are chosen. Influence of each of them upon the technological process is described. Some non-staff situations that may arise during drying process are given

articleTitle: Moisture control in bulk materials by means of microwave methods
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The realization of the microwave-measuring device for bulk material moisture control is discussed in the present paper. The homodyne methods of amplitude and phase measurements are used. These methods provide high accuracy of measurements. The choosing of working frequency of measuring device is discussed, taking into account resolution ratio and matter attenuation

articleTitle: Application of composite and defined basic elements in full cycle microwave stripline CAD system
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In article considered some new features of interactive program for the stripline CAD system. This system is only one from four parts of integrated system "LAMBDA+". Stripline CAD system allows to design circuits, based on different types of microstrip lines and their combinations

articleTitle: Mobile communication networks planning using multilayered covering model
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of mobile communication networks planning for territories with a low traffic intensity is offered on the basis of multilayered covering model providing the required level of communication reliability.

articleTitle: Application of PSK demodulator using a system of coupled oscillators in EOS receiving station
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Processes in a system of coupled oscillators synchronized with phase-splitted external signal are adequately described with single equation containing phase of vector sum of partial oscillators. By its dynamic properties the system is similar to first order PLL and is well capable to serve instead it in data receivers.

articleTitle: Linear non-stationary vortex structures on magnetostatic waves in magnetic films
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A possibility of excitation of the vortex structures using the interaction of three pulses of the linear forward volume magnetostatic waves (FVMSWs) in the normally magnetized ferrite film (FF) is shown

articleTitle: Calculation of nonconverting taper structure for TE/sub 01/ modes in gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Calculations and analysis of nonconverting taper for circular waveguide with operating TE/sub 01/ mode are presented. Calculations are carried out on the basis of discretely defined T-functions. The results obtained were checked by alternative method of finite elements which is incorporated in widely spread program.

articleTitle: Calculation of general characteristics of corrugated periodic waveguide filter
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We investigated the general characteristics of waveguide-filter on the basis of corrugated waveguide calculation technique with the use of T-functions. Single-mode operation is obtained in waveguide by setting the radius and signal operating frequencies.

articleTitle: Computerized system for functional status of electronics operators diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The computerized system allowing to determine the functional state of operators of radioelectronic stations is designed. The system consists of 4 channels: skin resistance, tremor, voice and NIB (not known earlier phenomenon). The diagnostic time is about 2 min. The developed system does not require special sensors and is very simple in use

articleTitle: Principles of efficient corporate networks design
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the analysis of criteria of efficient telecommunication networks design and recommendation on the choice of technology and topology.

articleTitle: Errors of microwave multiprobe multimeter with equidistant and nonequidistant sensors
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Compared in this paper is the accuracy of two algorithms of multi-probe microwave multimeters within operating frequency range with equidistant and non-equidistant probes location. The probes position and algorithms of their signals processing are taken into consideration

articleTitle: Polarization structure of multibeam spherical reflector antenna radiation field
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Mathematical model of multibeam antenna radiation field with helical feed is presented. Some results of radiation field modeling are given, as well as estimation of effective zone on reflector surface is performed. Value overlapped zones influence, which are created with adjacent feeds, on characteristics of reflector antenna radiation is shown. The minimal accessible angle value between radiators is shown. Maximal angle limits of feed scanning, which prevent characteristics of reflector antenna radiation from distortion.

articleTitle: Designs of applicators of a microwave plasmatrones for technological application
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A classification of microwave plasmatrones for technological application accomplished in view of the design features of microwave applicators is submitted. The specific features of typical designs of microwave applicators of the electrode and non-electrode types were considered. The developed classification of microwave plasmatrones in view of the design-technical characteristics of microwave energy applicators will be useful not only at the stage of studying and analyzing well-known technical variants of the given type plasma sources, but also at the design stage and while choosing the type of plasma source to solve certain technical problems

articleTitle: Natural frequencies and coupling coefficients of open-edges and grounded-edges microstrip resonators
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Calculated and experimental dependencies of natural frequencies as functions of coupling length of two microstrip resonators are compared. The calculations of one-dimensional models were carried out in quasi-TEM approach and good agreement with experimental data was obtained. The round out behavior of natural frequencies well agrees with the results obtained for interacting contours at presence between them simultaneously inductive and capacitive coupling

articleTitle: Coupled microstrip lines class-E oscillator
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Class-E oscillator on coupled microstrip with MESFET CLY5 was designed and investigated. Two case of coupling was proposed. The obtained efficiency was greater then 68% with output power 410 mW on frequency 800 MHz.

articleTitle: New ways to boost performance of CAD software
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, new ways to boost performance of CAD software are suggested: decreasing simulations time, increasing accuracy and reliability, minimizing resource consumption. Considered problems facing modem CAD systems. Considered main quantitative characteristics of CAD systems. Emphasized problems of decreasing simulation time, obtaining results with specified accuracy, reliability, resource consumption. Suggested ways to improve each of the characteristics. Suggested ways of improving performance by employing parallel computation and diacoptics techniques

articleTitle: Nonlinear model of resonant transmission line with magnetostatic waves
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the proposed paper the nonlinear model of resonant transmission line with magneto-static waves in the form of the equivalent circuit with lumped parameters is developed

articleTitle: Calculation of peniotron electron gun for technology applications
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of simulation of peniotron electron gun for frequency 2450 MHz, operating on 1st harmonic gyroharmonic are given. Electron gun accelerate voltage is -10 kV, the beam rotational energy pumping parameter is W/sub s//W=0.83, q=2.2.

articleTitle: Experimental study of 2 MM orotron
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The experimental study of orotron tuning in 90 - 145 GHz frequency range is carried out for accelerating voltages up to 20 kV. Two period values of two-row periodic structures and three values of inter-row spacing have been investigated as well.

articleTitle: Optimization of broadband access system coverage range in conditions of frequencies sharing by ground and satellite fixed services systems
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is optimization model for reception of the best covering of an operation range of broadband access system in conditions of frequencies sharing by the fixed satellite service systems.

articleTitle: Microwave estimation of dental materials
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The aim of this paper is to estimate the compatibility of root canal sealers with dental hard tissues by microwaves. Irradiative abilities of dental root sealers and their compatibility with tooth structures were studied. The results of these investigations could be useful for additional estimation to new endohermetics creation and for clinical choice

articleTitle: Analysis of S-parameters modules sensitivity of waveguide measurement cell for low loss dielectric case
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper are sensitivity coefficients for modules of S-parameters of waveguide measuring cell depending on thickness of dielectric layer, its permeability and wavelength in the case of low loss dielectric. Some recommendations regarding the choice of optimal measurement frequency are given

articleTitle: The meter calibration of vector ratio of two microwave signals
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the calibration method of the vector ratio meter, built on the basis of the microwave converter of parametric type. Calibration procedure is based on using certified power divider (PD) and the standard segments of transmission lines (STL). The solution of the calibration equations systems is carried out

articleTitle: Antenna-preselector with discrete frequency tuning and adjusting bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Resonant magnetic antenna with adjusting bandwidth and discrete frequency tuning in wide frequency range is considered. The proposed antenna can be narrowband preselector with adjusting bandwidth and discrete frequency tuning for receivers with wideband input circuit. Structure of antenna with digital control from receiver is considered. The antenna consists of diode switch, wideband antenna amplifier and control circuit. Control signals and supply voltage are from the receiver by means of coaxial cable.

articleTitle: The coaxial-collinear antenna of advanced manufacturability
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of investigation the coaxial-collinear antenna with advanced manufacturability are presented. The antenna is a packed cophasal array on the coaxial feeder basis having circumferential slots in its outer conductor, spaced with distances /spl lambda//sub /spl epsi// and 2/spl lambda//sub /spl epsi// and coaxially covered with half-wavelength sections.

articleTitle: Devices for generation of broadband noise-like oscillations with the help of non-relativistic electron beam with virtual cathode
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This report presents the results of theoretical and experimental investigations of sources of wideband noise-type oscillations (WNTO) of SHF range based on intensive nonrelativistic electron beams with virtual cathode (VC)

articleTitle: Radiating properties of weak electrolytes in electrical discharge field
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are results of experimental research of discharge processes in water solutions with impurities under the influence of electrical current. Several developmental stages of discharge processes accompanied by both emissions of electrically charged plasmoids from water medium and electromagnetic radiation with hard quantum are detected. The qualitative model explaining observed phenomena is also given

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a crystal band-pass filter using commercial elements and computer simulation
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A crystal band-pass filter is designed and implemented using commercial elements and with the help of a computer aided design method. It has been shown that the spurious resonances of the quartz crystals may affect the upper stop band of the designed filter considerably. Excellent agreement between the simulated and the measured results shows the validity of simulation

articleTitle: AlGaN/GaN power HEMT for Ka-band
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of design and manufacturing of power AlGaN/GaN HEMT for Ka-band are submitted. It has Pout = 1, 4W/mm, efficiency 33% at F = 35 GHz.

articleTitle: Microstrip sensor for monitoring proportion of liquids in piping
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Two-resonator microstrip sensor with a tube-shaped ceramic substrate is presented. Its operation principle is based on the registration of depth and frequency of damping pole in the sensor frequency response. These parameters depend on the permittivity and loss tangent of a monitored liquid, which in their turn depend on liquid composition

articleTitle: Nondestructive radiometric technique for testing the density of quartz ceramics in radio transparent heat-resistant radomes
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Dependence has been experimentally measured between power levels of thermal EM self-radiation of quartz ceramics and its density at a fixed chemical composition. This research may be used as the basis for developing a nondestructive technique of testing density parameters of quartz ceramics during manufacture of radio transparent heat-resistant radomes from inorganic materials

articleTitle: Estimation of deep levels effect on recovery time of low noise amplifiers under power pulse
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Typical depths and rechargeable times for deep levels in low noise field effect transistors under the power pulse depending on f transistor parameters, pulse amplitude, electron capture cross-section have been estimated. Based on this estimations and experimental date, including measured noise figure and associated gain of typical transistors, the parasitical buffer layer conductance effect on performance of low noise amplifier with bipolar power supply and unipolar power supply has been analyzed. It is shown that noise figure of amplifier under power pulse can be increased twice for bipolar power supply and tree times for unipolar power supply

articleTitle: Mathematical methods for analysis of GPRS systems quality operation
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Discussed in the paper are the methods for estimation of service of claims, which come to the base station of GPRS system.

articleTitle: Open resonators with resonant conductive inserts for millimeter wave sources
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The features of resonant modes in two-dimension open resonators with conductive inserts are considered. The effect of increasing of Q-factor of resonant modes in open resonator with one and two cylindrical inserts with a diameter, sufficient for constructive accommodation and cooling of active elements, is found out

articleTitle: Properties of communication system with matroid coding
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the analysis of code characteristics for matroid codes and code gain at their use in communication systems. Also, the algorithm for generation of the optimal multiplier scheme over extended Galois field is presented.

articleTitle: Regular nanocones on carbon-silicon composite surface
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is a new effect of nanostructuring, namely the formation of nano-cones under the action of local electric field induced in carbon-silicon composite films underneath the SPM probe.

articleTitle: Self-synchronization of oscillations in microwave generators with sustained electron-wave interaction
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper discusses the problems of self-oscillations self-synchronization in generators with sustained electron-wave interaction. A multidimensional system of nonlinear equations is presented to define the generator output characteristics with regards to a secondary channel of positive feedback. Calculations of electron efficiency, electron frequency bias, stabilization factor have been carried out, advantages of the system are listed.

articleTitle: Implementation of mobile broadband radioaccess systems on the basis of MIMO technology
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: New foundations of implementing of modem equipment for microwave broadband radio access systems that provide simultaneous access to Ethernet local area networks and public switched telephone networks ISDN PRI are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of characteristics of electrode system EEG
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the analysis of electric circuit of the electrode system used at EEG is presented. Registration of cerebral cortex signals, or EEG, allows to carry out monitoring of brain activity and is the best diagnostic method for revealing pathological conditions of a brain, for example, epilepsy. Frequency dependence of transfer function of electrode system is determined by character of circuit impedances and essentially depends on electrode type. The opportunity of use of non-gel contact system is also shown

articleTitle: Last mile data transmission RRL
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Additional modules, RRL advanced technical decisions given on the 13/sub th/ CriMiCo conference are considered. It enables to transmit E3-stream over RRL signals, to introduce Internet 10 BASE T signals and V.35 interface signals into E1-stream, and to transmit DOCSIS signals.

articleTitle: Modulation measurement method of dielectric permeability in substructures of strip lines
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The measurement method of dielectric permeability, which is based on frequency-modulated signal analysis, was examined. The given method allows automating completely the measurement process and determining the effective dielectric permeability with an error factor insignificant enough for designing of microwave systems, as well as for quality control when manufacturing transmission lines

articleTitle: Waveguide adapters in 3-mode exciter
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The round-rectangular waveguide adapter is considered. The design characteristics of matching, isolation and junction example are given presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of chaotic synchronization in beam-plasma systems with overcritical current
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present report deals with investigation of the generalized chaotic synchronization appearance in unidirectionally coupled spatially extended beam-plasma systems with overcritical current (fluid models of Pierce diode).

articleTitle: Radio-frequency interference effects in semiconductor devices
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Radio-frequency interference (RFI) effects in semiconductor devices are considered. The dependence of microwave-induced interference signal on microwave intensity and frequency is analyzed

articleTitle: Filter based on microstrip resonators with lumped capacitance between ends
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of lumped capacitance connected between opposite ends of microstrip resonator strip conductor on frequency of transmission zero near to resonator natural frequency is investigated. It is shown that the design of hybrid filter based on such resonator allows to form transmission zeroes at required frequencies. The filter central frequency and fractional bandwidth is invariable. It allows to provide highest dumping at fixed frequencies and control slopes steepness of filter frequency response

articleTitle: The analysis of waveguide-finline with dielectric insertion in slot
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the comparative electrodynamics analysis of the waveguide-finline structure (WFL) and WFL with dielectric insertion in slot are presented

articleTitle: DC-4 GHz GaAs MMIC determined SPDT switch
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: DC to 4 GHz broadband microwave monolithic GaAs determined SPDT switch 1.7/spl times/1.1/spl times/0.125 mm has been developed. Insertion loss better than 2.2 dB and isolation more than 45 dB have been achieved.

articleTitle: The microwave vibration meter
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The microwave vibration meter development results are presented. The vibration meter functioning principle are presented. Thus by engineering implementation of the meter, it applies a modulated probing signal and digital filtering and demodulation of intermediate-frequency signals to improve the signal-to-noise ratio

articleTitle: Resonator for absorbent rapid regeneration in the electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes resonator for absorbent rapid regeneration in the electromagnetic field. The technology of absorbent drying in the HF electromagnetic field can solve this problem. The main target is to evaluate absorber construction influence on electromagnetic and temperature field distribution in absorber cross-section. Thus 4-edge absorber has been used in order to possess best parameters for high speed absorbent regeneration

articleTitle: Orthogonal chaotic coding for telecommunication system with wideband wireless access
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Orthogonal chaotic code sets are constructed for wireless telecommunication system with a wideband multiple access on the basis of radioEthernet technology. It is shown that an orthogonal chaotic code application is permitted to provide low interference between channel waveforms, to increase the information capacity, and to save transmitted information.

articleTitle: Coding system and amplifier wideband ruler for commercial TV broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of creation of coding/decoding system and wideband amplifier ruler in the band 470-862 MHz with output power 1 W, 10 W, 100 W.

articleTitle: Scanning near-field optical microscope probes: fabrication and properties
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of scanning near-field optical microscope (SNOM) probe fabrication with high transmission coefficients on the base of tapered single-mode optical fiber are studied. The various methods of improvement of resolution of SNOM and application for modification and diagnostics of sample surface are discussed

articleTitle: The DRO with increasing field in the interaction space like a consequence of coupled cavities
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A possibility is experimentally shown for enhancing the oscillation power of the diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO) when the interaction space is designed as a consequence of coupled cavities (CCC) and the field is built up in the electron beam direction.

articleTitle: Operational model of microwave heliospectrometer
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the description of heliospectrometer model, intended for measurement of solar radiation spectrum

articleTitle: Radio Ethernet transceiver for 5150-5350 MHz and 5725-5825 MHz bands
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Technical decisions and characteristics of RTA for Ethernet signals transmission within 5150-5350 MHz, 5725-5825 MHz bands are considered.

articleTitle: Calibration signal formation for microwave noise meter
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In order to carry out microwave noise meter calibration it is necessary to determine parameters and working conditions of a calibration unit. Accuracy of calibration signal formation, used algorithms of calibration determine metrological characteristics of whole microwave noise meter. Theoretical and experimental researches of microwave noise meter calibration unit using modulation method are carried out. Conditions of amplitude and frequency modulation formations for input microwave signal are determined

articleTitle: Increased accuracy of frequency difference measurements by microwave resonance sensors
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A possibility of improving the accuracy of measuring small frequency detuning of low-Q resonance sensors is discussed, a measuring instrument function chart is presented and the algorithm of its operation is described

articleTitle: Effect of multiband feed radiation patterns on electrical characteristics of reflector antennas
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Design procedure and results of the performance calculation for multi-frequency band UHF-EHF Cassegrain antennas, dual-reflector antennas with elliptical primary reflector generatrix and Gregorian antennas are presented in the paper taking into account the phase characteristics of feeding irradiator.

articleTitle: Reflex triode oscillation frequency tuning
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The methods used for reflex triode oscillation frequency tuning within the range of 1.8-2.8 GHz are described. Reflex triode was driven by the generator with output voltage of 600 kV capable to deliver 25 kA current into the load. Radiated pulse energy in both single pulse mode and pulse repetition mode of operation (pulse repetition rate 1 Hz) was about 4 J

articleTitle: Electromechanically tunable filter with impedance step
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: New principle of microstrip resonator and filter tuning is developed and studied. Realized idea is the operation by substrate effective dielectric constant (epsiv<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub>) piezo-controlling. Narrow air gap (Delta) is created between substrate and ground electrode, and the piezoelectric plate controls its size. The changing of epsiv<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub>(Delta) leads to the variation of filter resonant frequency

articleTitle: Development of methodic and analysis software support and technological optimization of SHF control items parameters on microstrip
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this research work we analyze the condition of modern SHF control items design on volumetric integrated circuit, the elemental base of creation of modern control items and the main control elements such as phase changer, switchers, attenuators. We also analyze the influence of destabilizing engineering and designing factors. The use of existing mathematical models of asymmetric microstrip parameters (impedance, effective inductive capacity, attenuation per unit length) not always allows to design SHF devises. One of the reasons for it is that inaccuracies caused by the technological process of production are not taken into account

articleTitle: Algorithms for improve in the problems of angular resolution
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes how the angular resolution of radar systems can be improved in the problems of the target image identification. Rather simple algorithms, necessary for it, of an information reprocessing are proposed for practical embodiment. The outcomes of numerical experiments are introduced

articleTitle: 6-cm wave length switcher
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Coaxial-waveguide switch at frequency band 4.8-5.3 GHz has been considered. The switch is intended for receiver protection. The losses in ON state are at the most 0.4 dB. The protection in OFF state is more than 50 dB at input power up to 50 W.

articleTitle: Numerical model of effective dielectric permeability of disperse environments on the microwave
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Grounded in this paper is numerical-analytical algorithm for research of efficient complex dielectric permeability of fine-dispersed environments in microwave band on the basis of strict electrodynamic proportions. Conditions of modelling and posing of practical measurements at which both components of complex dielectric permeability of structurally non-uniform objects have weak contribution of non-local part of interaction are described

articleTitle: Ultra-wide band pulse signal use in long-range radio communication systems
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper sets limits to pulse duration and communication range caused by dispersion distortions for different models of stratified nonuniform ionosphere. The paper reveals dependence of pulse distortions on their duration and incidence angle, establishes parameter value intervals which allow high-speed long-range radio communication.

articleTitle: Problems of quantum devices electric characteristics modeling
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The basic problems that exist in the field of modeling the electric characteristics of quantum devices are declared. It is claimed that the traditional approaches do not provide for full and closed description of charge transport in mesoscopic structures

articleTitle: Boloniya declaration and quality of higher education
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in the present paper are the questions of further revision of higher education system in context of the main theses of Boloniya declaration.

articleTitle: A three-cycle modulation method to increase the accuracy of weak radio emissions measurements
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper are the structure and operative algorithm of a weak-emissions meter that enable high measurement sensitivity and accuracy, elimination of the influence of additive and multiplicative error components from the influence of the receiving antenna self-noise and parameter instability of the emission-measuring equipment

articleTitle: Experimental research of microwave noise meter
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The researches of metrology parameters of microwave signal amplitude, frequency and insertion phase noise meter are carried out for two calibration methods. The measuring error is determined by an installation and measurement by spectral methods error of modulation parameter for microwave calibration signal. Practically, usage of the offered calibration unit allows removing an error dependent on analyzing frequency, and reducing error dependent on value of an input signal. Also the sensitivity of three kinds noise of microwave signal measurements with the help of a designed meter MNM 78-118 are determined

articleTitle: The screen with photooperated electrodynamic performances
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Electrodynamic characteristics of the photooperated screen which represents the single-layer or two-layer metal perforated structure are considered. Experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Investigations of resonance characteristics of DRO electrodynamic systems with automated measuring system in 4 mm wave range
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of study of long-focus and short-focus open resonators (OR) of diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO) by means of automated measuring system (AMS) in the 4-mm wave band. AMS implements frequency tuning of signal oscillator within 53.57-63.37 GHz via 10 MHz step complemented by the ability of a minimal step 160 kHz within 600 MHz bandwidth. Microwave field amplitude was measured at every point of frequency range. This system allows to study resonance systems with Q up to 5/spl divide/7/spl times/10/sup 4/.

articleTitle: Design of impedance-matching elements for magnetostatic wave transducers
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A design method of impedance-matching network for magnetostatic wave transducers is offered. The results of calculation of input VSWR for microstrip magnetostatic wave transducers with matching shot-circuit and open-circuit microstrip stubs are presented

articleTitle: Ground return deembedding in stepped-frequency ground penetrating radar
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Two different signal processing techniques, namely a principal component analysis (PCA) and wavelet-based scan have been analyzed from the viewpoint of their viability for ground return removal in subsurface sensing

articleTitle: A new approach in manufacturing diode protection
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A device operating as a microwave power limiter in passive mode and switch mode when external control signal is applied has been created.

articleTitle: Analysis of transients quality for a self-adjusting system in a low-parametric SHF-focusing RTS
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A low-parametric SHF-focusing radiotechnical system is a new dynamically developing class of radio engineering systems capable of addressing problems of near-field radars (Fresnel zone). This paper presents the results of analyzing transients quality of a self-adjusting system in a low-parametric SHF-focusing RTS

articleTitle: Variations in electrokinetic properties of cell nuclei under influence of EM-irradiated water
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The goal of the study is to compare the response of native human buccal epithelium cells exposed to extremely high frequency (EHF) electromagnetic field in water with that of cells suspended in pre-irradiated water. Electrophoretic mobility of cell nuclei in electric field has served as a quantitative indicator of this response (electronegative nuclei (ENN))

articleTitle: Parity and resonance levels expansion in triple-barrier quantum structures under HF electric field
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Exact analytical steady-state solution of the time-dependence Schrodinger equations at resonance in small signal HF electric field is found as well as expression for HF active conductivity. Very simple method for calculation of quantum levels width has been generalized and expression for quantum levels width of triple-barrier structures has been obtained. This method is based on analysis of determinant of liner equation set for electron transport in quantum structure. It is shown that if the levels in each quantum well forming the resonance level of the whole structure have the different parity, the resonance level width and integral HF structure conductance can rise many times. Respectively, the electron life time in structure decreases many times, so the conditions for electron to leave the structure without electron-phonon collision can be simply realized, so one has the real way for ballistic electron transport quantum-cascade laser realization

articleTitle: Ring antenna array with cylindrical reflector
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The directed properties by the ring antenna array (RAA) of linear radiators with a cylindrical reflector are considered. The opportunity of use such RAA as the antenna of mobile communication system base station is discussed.

articleTitle: Models of nanoelectronic devices on single-electron, resonant tunneling effects and quantum wires for nano and microsystem equipment
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The models of nanoelectronic devices on single-electron tunneling, resonant tunneling effects and quantum wires are described. These models have been included into a new version of nanoelectronic device simulator NANODEV for PC. New models allow to simulate other devices including more complex structures. Principles of simulator design have been left without change. At present, we use several formalisms such formalism of wave functions, formalism of scattering matrix and formalism of Wigner function. For each class of nanoelectronic devices, different hierarchy models can be used. The principles allow to realize modification of the system in order to increase its possibilities

articleTitle: On perfection of higher technical education. Didactic aspect
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article is dedicated to a problem of further perfection of higher technical education in the context of the ideas of Euro-integration of higher school. The definite didactic technique of education process in technical university is discussed.

articleTitle: The conceptional position of pedagogic designing
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article is dedicated to the problems of pedagogic designing conformably to higher technical school. The stages of formation and conceptual foundation of project construction were depicted.

articleTitle: Frequency discriminator for the device of a frequency switching time measurement
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is offered the design of frequency discriminator allowing to define process of frequency switching in UHF oscillators with electronic frequency tuning

articleTitle: Wunsch-Bell criterion dependency for silicon FET
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of electrothermal process calculations in FET are given. Calculations performed in avalanche breakdown mode till Au (used as gate substrate) melting point and achieved in any lattice point in active FET area. Discrete FET model is used to perform calculations

articleTitle: Modeling of radiopaths for mobile communication systems in the presence of shading produced by forest
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design procedure for of electromagnetic field strength behind the forest canopy layer for dual mechanism of wave propagation in case of radio transmitter installed at a big height is presented. A comparative analysis of contribution of diffraction and refraction electric field components forming the resultant field at a point of reception for vertical and horizontal polarizations is realized. Comparison of experimental and calculated results at 200 MHz frequency is executed

articleTitle: Radiating characteristics of single slot in the shield of strip dielectric waveguide
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Investigated in this paper is the influence of single resonance slot geometry in shield of strip dielectric waveguide on energetic characteristics of radiation system. The carried out investigations show possibility of operation of radiating characteristics by changing of characteristics of single discontinuity, which allows forecasting creation of high effective radiating systems in millimeter band

articleTitle: Opportunity of gain and linearity increase in television IOT
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An opportunity gain increasing in inductive output tubes using two-gap input resonator is considered. Linearity of the device can be improved provided low-frequency video signal at the tube input.

articleTitle: Tristron: the frequency tripler
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the results of calculating third-harmonic static and dynamic modes for tristron (frequency multiplier). A possibility of designing a third-harmonic multiplier tristron delivering high efficiency and power is shown.

articleTitle: The scattering characteristics of the microstrip reflectarray with impedance stubs
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of numerical research the scattering characteristics of a microstrip-stubs reflectarrays, using the mathematical model, developed by the authors, are represented. The mathematical model of a reflectarray allows installing in construction of microstrip elements certain stubs with controllable loads. The numerical simulation results of scattering characteristics of a microstrip-stub reflectarrays are presented. It is shown, that due to stubs it is possible to control amplitude and phase of a scattering fields.

articleTitle: Technique of computer modelling in a laboratory practical work on telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The technique of computer modeling in a laboratory practical work on synchronization processes in telecommunication systems is studied in the present article.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of dielectric parameters of two-layer structures by means of open resonators in the millimeter wave-band
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principles of measurement of UHF parameters of two-layer structures: the dielectric permittivity (epsiv) and the loss tangent (tgdelta) using open resonators are presented. These principles are based on the measurement of open resonator characteristics-the Q-factor and the resonance frequency-when putting the sample under investigation into the resonance volume

articleTitle: Influence of distance changing between liquid surface and equatorial surface of hemispherical dielectric resonator on whispering gallery oscillations
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental investigations of hemispherical dielectric resonator (HDR) placed above the liquid surface have been carried out The influence of liquid dielectric properties on HDR parameters has been shown. The fact that the parameters of E-type oscillations are more sensitive to dielectric properties of liquid (compared with H-type oscillations) is established.

articleTitle: Digital system of the granting multimedia and broadcasting services MIDIS
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper considers technologies used in system MITRIS-INT for granting abonent access to communication and information serve.

articleTitle: Inverse problems of subsurface probing
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of identification of subsurface areas and objects the approach of their geometrical and physical properties reconstruction is offered. Presented in this paper are the results of numerical simulation of the basic stages

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of shielded microstriplines with resistive films in substrate
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of experimental investigations the shielded microstrip lines (SML) with resistive films in substrate and comparison with theoretical calculations are described in the paper

articleTitle: Optimization of antenna spacing in antenna array for ground penetrating radar
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The optimal distance between transmitting and receiving antennas in the array for detecting antipersonnel mines buried at shallow depth has been determined. The scanning method with small step has been proposed

articleTitle: Features of wave distribution in periodic system such as a coupled nonidentical cavity chain close to the passband boundaries

articleTitle: Coming revolution in communication - true software radio systems

The latter, exemplified by TechnoConcepts Inc's. TSR system, an industry first, provides conversion of received signals into its digital equivalent immediately after antenna. Radar output signal has a complicated shape which is a combination of discrete LFM signal with DeltaF=500 MHz and f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dis </sub>=1 MHz, and time of frequency change 2 ns or lower, time of holding each frequency t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">hold</sub>=50 mus, and additional phase-code modulation (M-sequence) with 0deg and 180deg phase. Length of M-sequence element-4 ns, phase switching time-2 ns. Output power is 20 mW

articleTitle: Calculation of waveguide section with nonlinear device disk-pin holder scattering parameters
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A model of a waveguide section with a disk-pin nonlinear device holder is presented. The model is based on the known solution of an electrodynamics problem of excitation of an infinite waveguide by the disk-pin holder and enables to calculate its scattering parameters

articleTitle: Some features of the land mobile CDMA networks ecological safety
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper discusses the influence of system characteristics (traffic intensity, power adjustment, site size) networks of the radio communication using technology CDMA, on network ecological characteristics.

articleTitle: Directional antenna for subscriber stations of cellular networks
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Sufficient BS signal level and minimal interferences at SS receiver at "uncertain" areas are possible when using high-altitude panel antennas with narrow radiation pattern and insignificant side lobes in horizontal plane. Panel antenna possesses such properties. It represents horizontal grid made of zigzag antennas.

articleTitle: Broadband power divider-combiner
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper are the results of experimental and theoretical improvement of characteristics of broadband tandem power divider-combiner, intended for use in S-range solid-state microwaves amplifiers

articleTitle: Slots in a shielded microstrip line
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analysis of electrodynamic characteristics of slots with arbitrary electrical length and cut in a shielded microstrip line is performed

articleTitle: Gyrotron on opened goffered cavity
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This report is dedicated to study of the possibility of designing a new type of electronic device - girotona on the goffered open resonator, in which the three-dimensional bunching of electron beam does not occur; however, reaching the high efficiency of the conversion of the power of electrons beam into the power of the electromagnetic revolving wave is possible. Rectilinear at entrance the electrons beam due to its initial deviation from the axis by retarded E/sub 11/ wave then returns its longitudinal energy to the same wave with the efficiency 74%.

articleTitle: Research of the filter, which blocks the cathode of multiwave Cherenkov's oscillator
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of the strict electrodynamic theory influence of geometrical parameters on frequency band properties blocking the cathode of the Cherenkov's oscillator, the filter executed as resonant grooves is investigated. Updating of a method of the block matrix prorace, raising its speed in one and a half time is offered.

articleTitle: The results of polarized light use for research of tensely-deformed eye state
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The optical anisotropy of alive eye cornea has the photoelastic nature and is caused by stretching action of oculomotor muscles and intraocular pressure. In this paper, the results of eye tensely-deformed conditions model for using in differential diagnostics of oculomotor muscles pathology are presented

articleTitle: The concept of digital telephony development in the suburb
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposed in the paper is the concept of development of digital telephony in the suburb. The possibility of organization of symmetrical data communication with 256 kbit/s for the group of four users is considered.

articleTitle: Noninvasive method for definition of blood viscosity properties using parameters of pulse wave
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The purpose of the given paper is the development of mathematical model, which would define the viscosity of blood behind parameters of last front of pulse wave. The received results have good presentation and can be used for diagnostics in a direct kind, as this model enables definitions of viscosity properties of blood by noninvasive method, and also opportunity of the continuous control behind the patient

articleTitle: Resonance method for measuring the reflection and transmission coefficients of directional coupler
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new method for measuring of complex reflection and transmission coefficients from the region with coupling holes of a rectangular waveguide with directional coupler is proposed. The method is based on measurements of the resonance characteristics of waveguide section excited through inductive diaphragm

articleTitle: Measurement of the orientation and transitive attenuation of directed coupler/the activator of the ring resonator
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of orientation and transitive attenuation determination of a directed coupler (the activator of the ring running wave resonator) with the help of reflectometer of the reflection and drive complex factors modules is considered

articleTitle: The phaseless control method of the antenna currents distribution for course airport beacon of the landing system
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The phaseless control method of the antenna current distributions for a course airport beacon of the landing C/spl Pi/-90 system is considered.

articleTitle: About additional matching possibilities of sectioned microstrip antennas
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: New modifications of sectioned microstrip antennas are discussed from matching possibilities point of view. Variants of matching schemes on the basis of series and parallel lumped reactance are considered.

articleTitle: Chaos and structure formation in non-relativistic electron beam with virtual cathode
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present report deals with theoretical and experimental research of oscillatory processes in an electron beam with virtual cathode (VC). The purpose of this work is the investigation of physical mechanisms which lead to the chaotic generation in the systems with VC (vircators)

articleTitle: Hemispherical isotropic dielectric resonator with idealy conductive flat surface
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The eigen oscillations of a hemispherical isotropic dielectric resonator placed on an ideally conductive flat surface are studied. It is shown that for independent E and H modes of resonator the sums of polar and azimuthal indexes have odd and even values, accordingly. The distribution of the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">36361</sub> "whispering gallery" mode fields is shown on the hemispherical surface and conductive plane outside of the hemisphere. Quantities of field variations over spherical coordinates are compared to the mode indexes of the eigen oscillations of resonator. The dependences of eigen frequencies and Q-factors of the resonator buried into isotropic medium of different substances are shown in the millimeter wave band

articleTitle: Method of accuracy improvement in auto radar
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Methods of achieving better accuracy for determination of objects coordinates, along with speed measuring are described. That is achieved by using complicated signals where both phase and frequency are manipulated. Processing of reflected signals is carried out using fast Fourier transform and correlation analysis methods

articleTitle: Submillimeter laser power stabilizing system
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Simple electron-mechanical submillimeter HCN laser (lambda=0.337 mm) power stabilizing system on the basis of microcontroller MSP430 and stepping motor are represented. If we use this system, laser output stability amount is 2% for more than 2 hours

articleTitle: Polarization characteristics of circular waveguide in near- and far-zones
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of rigorous Weinstein's method, spherical wave expansion technique and the method of Hertz potentials, the polarization characteristics in near, intermediate and far zone of single mode and multimode waveguides excited by H/sub 11/ circular-polarized mode are investigated.

articleTitle: Oscillation process in the spiral magnetic cumulative generator with capacitance load
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The oscillations in the electric circuit of the spiral magnetic cumulative generator with capacitance load are described by the partial differential equations of the long line. The equations parameters are functions of time and coordinate

articleTitle: Hermetically sealed coaxial microstrip launchers with improved parameters for microware electronics
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Hermetically sealed coaxial microstrip launchers with coaxial lines 3.5/1.52 and 7/3.04 mm are designed. The main parameters of launchers are given in table. The launchers provide effective parameters of devices with WSWR level 1.3 and RF insertion loss level 0.2 dB. The frequency range for two types of launchers makes up from DC to 18 GHz. The impedance is 50 Omega

articleTitle: Fine structure of diffraction radiation in DRO
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Theory of the fine structure of electron beam radiation in diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO) has been constructed. It shows that appearance of plasma waves of spatial charge in the electron beam may cause energy losses from the open resonator volume. The theory is verified with experiments.

articleTitle: Detection of spatial zones with known scattering characteristics in multiposition SAR
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Algorithm of spatial zones detection with known scattering coefficient in multiposition synthetic aperture radar is proposed and analyzed

articleTitle: Broadband power limiter
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are results of design and manufacture of broadband limiter MIC (1...18 GHz), based on GaAs p-i-n diodes. The limiter can be used as devices for protection of input low noise amplifiers, input signal level limiter for broadband power amplifiers.

articleTitle: Calculation of transfer functions for a model of self-adjusting system in a low parametric SHF-focusing RTS
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A low-parametric SHF-focusing radiotechnical system is a new dynamically developing class of radio engineering systems capable of addressing problems of near-field radars (Fresnel zone). This paper presents the results of calculating transfer functions for a model of self-adjusting system in a low-parametric SHF-focusing RTS

articleTitle: MM-range EMF in the treatment of osteoarthrosis
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We have studied the condition and changes in peripheral blood circulation and dynamics of patients' status, intensity of pain syndrome in gonarthrosis and coxarthrosis cases under microwave resonance treatment. In particular, muscular system state, as well as the rate of muscular stretching and spasming has been investigated. The treatment has been found to normalize vascular tone and blood flow, improve muscular function, and considerably weaken pain intensity.

articleTitle: Multipurpose video signal processing unit
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Two-channel radar signal processing PCI card with 100 MHz sampling frequency quantization is considered.

articleTitle: Thermoelectromotive influence on current-voltage characteristics of quantum wire
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
