articleTitle: Modeling of single-electron 1D and 2D arrays using physical models
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper are the results of single-electron 1D and 2D arrays simulation using physical models modified taking into account the influence of cross-section sizes (spatial quantization) and parasitic co-tunneling effect

articleTitle: Potential applications of spatially developed resonance structures in diffraction electronics
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of investigating coupled open resonators and open electrodynamic systems with metal-dielectric structures are summarized. These results may be used in the design of modified versions of EHF amplification, generator and selection devices.

articleTitle: New organization forms of scientific centers cooperation and introduction of technological improvement in Poland
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the practice of introduction of innovated technologies in context of technological progress development in Poland.

articleTitle: On teaching of the course of physics in the technical university
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problems of the further perfecting of methodic of teaching of the general course of physics in the technical universities are viewed in the article.

articleTitle: Influence of absorber termination quality in the GTEM cell on the RF radiation measurement
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The calibration technique for the RF radiation measurement in GTEM cell is elaborated. The technique takes into account real reflection from non-ideal absorber termination of the GTEM cell and gives an opportunity to improve measurement accuracy

articleTitle: LFM-700 multifunctional measuring device for CTV
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: LFM-700 device is considered here, it was designed and prepared for producing by "Beta TV com" enterprise, which is the future design of 500 and 600 series. In this device frequency windows in which signal analyses were not carried out are removed (862...950 MHz, 2150...2400 MHz), frequency range was enlarged from 2700 MHz (LFM 500 series) to 6000 MHz (LFM 700). There is a tendency to have generator HF, ALC meter, and spectrum analyzer in one device

articleTitle: Explosive plasma antennas
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of experimental investigations of parameters of a plasma jet generated by the explosive method have been submitted. Dispersion characteristics of the system "plasma jet-spiral" have been calculated on the basis of these data. The possibility of operation of an explosive plasma antenna in the mode of transverse radiation is shown

articleTitle: Excitation of magnetostatic surface waves by microstrip transducer with wide strip
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Numerical results on the radiation impedance per unit length of microstrip transducer with wide strip are presented. The features of excitation of magnetostatic surface waves with this transducer can be used for creation of microwave band-pass filters

articleTitle: Features of mm-band radio links
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the features of mm radio wave propagation in the atmosphere that cause waveform distortion, energy dissipation and absorption. Mathematical relations have been obtained defining deterioration in transmission accuracy over such radio links

articleTitle: S-band transistor chaotic oscillators on lumped elements
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A system of two coupled 3-point (Colpitts) generators is considered. The coupling circuit used allows to form the spectrum of chaotic signal in required frequency band.

articleTitle: Investigation of single and double microwave gap parameters in nonlinear mode
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Cavities with single and double microwave gaps are components of numerous generating and amplifying microwave devices. Usually energy exchange processes in these gaps are considered in a small-signal approximation, which yields analytical relationships for electron conductance and efficiency. The purpose of this work is to study induced currents, electron conduction, and efficiency of energy conversion in gaps without imposing restrictions on AC voltage amplitude.

articleTitle: Discriminatory characteristics of an optimal discriminator in a low-parametric focusing radiotechnical system
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A low-parametric radiotechnical system of microwave power focusing is a new class of radio engineering systems capable of addressing problems of near-field radars (Fresnel zone). In this article the results of analyzing operational capabilities of an adaptive low-parametric radiotechnical system of microwave power focusing are presented

articleTitle: Biological and information methods of physical and microwave stimulation of bone tissue regeneration
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Application of additional physical methods impacting on a damaged part of tissue accelerates regeneration processes and prevents secondary pathology (inflammatory processes, osteomyelitis, false knitting and etc). Control mechanism of renewal process (processes of adaptive growth) is the basis of physical impact methods. It is based on EHF external electromagnetic field influence on biophysical dynamic at cell structure membrane level. In particular, when external field is applied, the cells can change their natural vibration frequency thereby changing the protein structure of membranes, dynamic of membrane metabolic process etc. Stimulation of osseous tissue regeneration processes through galvanization and EHF EMI results in the initiation of reaction activating the organism, in the improvement of blood stream in the damaged joint fragments, eliminates the possibility of inflammatory complications, normalizes the psycho-physiological processes of organism

articleTitle: Influence of diaphragms geometry on transition radiation spectrum formation by electron bunches
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experiments on generating electromagnetic pulses (EMPs) using nonrelativistic electron bunches passing through diaphragms with various geometries are described. Results obtained agree with the predictions of the transition radiation theory as applied to nonrelativistic charged particles passing through apertured conducting screens. They may also be used in designing devices for generating EMPs with tunable characteristics, as well as in developing a transition radiation theory for electrodynamic structures of complex geometries

articleTitle: Accurate design of circularly polarized microstrip array antenna using multiport network model
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Microstrip patch antennas (MPAs) with circular polarization are used in many communication and radar systems. There are several methods and models in order to analyze and design these antennas including multiport network model (MNM). This model includes several circuit networks, that are connected to each other and each of them represents one characteristic of the MPA. Solution of this model is equivalent to calculation of the input and radiation parameters of the antenna. In this paper, a circularly polarized 2/spl times/2 array microstrip antenna with sequentially rotated elements is designed using the MNM.

articleTitle: Experimental determination of resonant-tunneling diode operating speed with taking into account the electrons lifetime in the quantum well
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper is the method for determination of electrons concentration and their lifetime in a quantum well of the resonant-tunneling diode, based on the analysis of its impedance frequency dependence. It is shown, that electrons lifetime in the quantum well of the diode can limit its operating speed essentially

articleTitle: The pedagogics of health
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The system of organization of the technical university students' health monitoring is viewed in the present article. The list of prophylactic events in the form of develop course "pedagogics of health" is cited.

articleTitle: Formation of creative abilities in the course of drawing
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problems of teaching of students of technical departments according to the level system of descriptive geometry, engineering and computer graphics are considered in this article.

articleTitle: A CAD tool for "visual" design of compensation and matching networks for microwave circuits
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A CAD tool, LOCUS, is presented for "visual" design of compensation and matching networks used in different RF and microwave active circuits. It is based on a visual representation of design process. LOCUS allows the user to select a suitable network configuration and to directly control all the network elements for successful fabrication

articleTitle: Design of mixers and transformers on GaAs
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design and performance of monolithic planar transformer and double-balanced mixer are described. In this paper different structures of GaAs-transformers are investigated. Mixers, based on it, have been designed

articleTitle: Microwave signal processing using phase conjugation of surface magnetostatic wave fronts
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: For the first time the possibility of microwave signal processing on the basis of phase conjugation effect for non-reciprocal surface magnetostatic wave fronts has been investigated

articleTitle: The near real time terminal for VLBI radar method
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Combination of radar and VLBI allowed obtaining the new scientific instrument for measurement of short-periodic variation of planet proper rotation and determination of the Solar system body orbits in the radio reference frame. Radar, spectral lines, low frequency, spacecraft navigation observations could benefit from this inexpensive solution in those stations where large antennas and sensitive receivers are available and where is still missing the possibility to be aligned with standard VLBI terminals, giving then yet the possibility to perform radio astronomy research. The Internet interfaces and software correlator for the near real-time VLBI radar researches were successfully tested. The echo-signals of 50 space debris objects at geostationary, high-elliptical and half-day orbits, Venus and Mars planets were detected

articleTitle: Microwave ferroelectric phase shifters based on the periodical structures
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Theoretical and experimental study of the micro wave phase-shifting lines periodically loaded by ferroelectric BaSrTiO/sub 3/ film capacitances included in parallel or in series is presented. Analysis of dispersion characteristics of similar lines demonstrates the possibility to design the ferroelectric phase shifters with the parasitic amplitude modulation radically sup pressed and the improved thermostability. Theoretical approach is confirmed by the experimental testing of different types of ferroelectric phase-shifters of k/sub a/ frequency band.

articleTitle: Universal radio apparatus of the point of receiving the information of distant zoning of earth from artificial earth satellites
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of design of universal equipment for information reception from different artificial satellites of Earth remote sensing. We have estimated perspective schematic designs for information reception from different artificial satellites using modern elements.

articleTitle: Influence of control grid geometry on structure of electron flow in multibeam IOT
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of control grid geometry on microstructure of electron flow in powerful multibeam IOT with individual fine-structure control grids in partial guns (beams) is considered. The guns with ring-shaped and radial control grids are compared. It is shown, that the gun with radial type grid forms an electron beam with smaller degradation of boundary and without azimuthal perturbations of current density.

articleTitle: Snap analysis of cardiovascular system based on inductance-capacitance heart model
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The goal of this paper is to discuss cardiac electrogenesis means of inductance-capacitance model and to show the importance of electric Q cardiac parameters in the studies and diagnostics of cardiovascular system. Based on the obtained results, the developed model along with ECGs may be used for snap analyses of the population's health condition

articleTitle: Airborne antenna systems development
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main problems of producing the multifunctional active on board phase antenna arrays (APAA) are considered. Variants of antenna array aperture constructions and feeding systems are discussed.

articleTitle: Synchronization circuit with galvanic isolation for high-current accelerator REB of microsecond duration
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the simple synchronization circuit with galvanic isolation. The main source of electromagnetic disturbances in high-current accelerator is ring current. Radical method of such interferences control is galvanic isolation

articleTitle: Monopulse characteristics of phased antenna array with wide angular scanning
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Monopulse characteristics of active multifunctional phased antenna arrays are considered. Monopulse far field patterns providing wide angle scanning in elevation plane within more than /spl plusmn/90/spl deg/ are presented.

articleTitle: Influence of the voltage bias on the magnetoresistance of magnetic tunneling junction
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of bias voltage on the value and the sign of tunneling magnetoresistance (TMR) in the ferromagnetic/insulator/ferromagnetic junction is studied

articleTitle: Perspective composites based onwire helix inclusions
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper deals with the selected results of investigation of composite materials exhibiting artificial magnetic properties at microwave frequencies owing to the resonant phenomena in nonmagnetic inclusions. In particular, inclusions are investigated in the form of small (compared with the wavelength) wire helixes of different shapes. It is demonstrated that the composites have effective magnetic properties in the vicinity of the eigenfrequencies of the inclusions. The frequency dispersion of the effective magnetic permeability of such materials is resonant. The applications of such composites for antenna techniques are presented

articleTitle: Forming creative abilities in the course of drawing
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Creative abilities of students during solution of complex constructive problems are considered in this article.

articleTitle: Ortoboron acid influence on dielectric permittivity of coolant moderator of WMWCPR
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of experimental study of permittivity of orthoboron acid (H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>BO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) water solution in centimeter and millimeter wave ranges are presented. The main goal of this work is to investigate orthoboron acid water solution with concentration values used in WMWCPR

articleTitle: Contactless methods and the equipment for measurement of semiconductor electrophysical parameters
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Diagnostics of electrophysical parameters of semiconductor materials is a necessary part of the manufacture technology both semi-conductor materials, and various devices on their basis. Contactless not destroying checking methods of the devices and installations are most suitable for these purposes. Installations and measuring resonators of the microwave range for contact determination of electrophysical parameters of semi-conductor materials (type of conductivity, specific resistance, and time of non-equilibrium charge carrier's life) in 80-3000 K temperature interval are offered. At high localness of measurements at the microwave range with the use of the resonator method the influence of zones bends arising on a semi-conductor surface at cooling, on results of definition of specific resistance volumetric and time of photo carriers life are described. Results of an experimental research of electrophysical and recombination characteristics of semiconductor materials are given

articleTitle: Mixed simulation of RF circuits and systems
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Method for communication link simulation is described which uses mixed multilevel simulation objects description. Example of simulation is provided to analyze power amplifier behavior in transmitter

articleTitle: Use the shaper package TV programs for transmission of information on analog channel of the transmission radio-relay type line
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper proposes ways of application of MPEG-2 shaper at transmission of multimedia information via analog channel of radio-relay type line (RRL). The possibility of transmission of multimedia information via existing radio-relay systems using the designed package shaper is considered. Presented here is the technology of digital TV-programs transmission via FM-channels. The transmitter uses flow inflection by method QAM-32 or QAM-64 and then flow symbol is warbled. The designed shaper makes it possible to realize the technology of DVB stream transmission via analog channel RRL.

articleTitle: Analysis of the circular polarization coupler broadbandness
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The mathematical model and the results of numerical analysis of circular polarization coupler (CPC) made of flat metal-dielectric strip waveguide (MDSW) for measuring polarization instrument to measure waveguide device complex parameters. The developed flat MDSW and CPC models allow taking into account waveguide dielectric losses

articleTitle: Estimation of a noise stability address code sets for CDMA-systems
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The technique for estimation of noise stability of address code sets for CDMA-systems is given. By means of the offered technique, the analysis of stability to channel distortions is presented.

articleTitle: Radioholographic polarized imaging
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper is devoted to the identification and localization of target, shielded by the optically opaque media, with the help of polarization radio-holographic imaging. The main goal is to test the ability of acquiring images for each of the orthogonal polarizations separately and comparing the visual identification of the polarization and classic radio-holography

articleTitle: Suspended substrate frequency quadraplexer
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Development results of a suspended substrate frequency quadraplexer are presented. The quadraplexer provides division of a wide strip of frequencies into four channels

articleTitle: The influence of dipole effect of evanescent waves on field distribution in slow wave structure such as coupled cavity chain with phase velocity jump of the wave
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are results of experimental research of amplitude and phase distribution to the length of slow-wave structure (chain of coupled cavities with jumping phase velocity of the wave). Significant influence of heterogeneity fields on waves transmission in the system close to the boundaries of its pass-band have been investigated.

articleTitle: Results of up-to-date medical equipment development using microwave technology
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Introduction of basic research achievements in the field of radio engineering and radio electronics, in particular microwave technology, into R&D works of modern medical equipment allows to enhance qualitative capability of the equipment and to enlarge considerably nomenclature of the active medical equipment. This paper deals with the results of new medical equipment development using HF welding and microwave heating

articleTitle: Microwave structures electromecanical reconfiguration for tunable devices elaboration
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Various highly tunable low-loss microwave devices are elaborated by piezoelectrically induced mechanical changes in the microwave structures utilizing high Q dielectrics. In this connection, an effective dielectric constant, epsi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub>, of used composite structures is controlled by fast actuator that results in energy distribution within the devices. Typical device consist of dielectric and metallic parts with an air gap between them that provides the largest perturbation in the electromagnetic field. By mini-actuator, the size of the air gap is changed and, as a result, the epsi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> can be tuned that is used for a device control. Highly tunable dielectric resonators as filters as well as wideband, low-loss phase shifters are realized experimentally

articleTitle: The model for a lipid being in the liquid-crystalline phase of blood plasma in human body
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the mathematical model for a lipid being in the liquid-crystalline phase is proposed. The temperature dependence of a free energy and the lipid order parameter was obtained. Formulas for the lipid dielectric anisotropy and for the order parameter determination in vivo by means of the anisotropy coefficient measurement by the method of reflectometry in mm-range were derived. The developed method of mm-range differential reflectometry makes it possible that electromagnetic waves, permeating the surface skin layers and reflecting from the surface of vessels may carry information about phase states of the lipids in the blood plasma. The results of the work can use in biological and medical researches and also in medical practice for the noninvasive diagnostics.

articleTitle: Application of the multi-channel probe for near field antenna measurements
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Some special problems of the multi-channel probe application for accuracy improvement of the near field antenna measurements are studied. Some special automated complexes, which allow saving time and cost during evaluation of the phased-array antenna (PAA) parameters for further aligning and conducting of acceptance tests are also considered in this report

articleTitle: Single-bit reradiating element for a reflection-type phased antenna array
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A low-cost X-band single-bit reradiating element for a reflection-type phased antenna array (RPAA) is proposed. The single-bit reradiating element operability has been confirmed experimentally. An experimental linear four-element section of a single-bit reradiating element-based RPAA has been designed and manufactured and its parameters have been measured. The measurement and computational results are in good agreement. Multielement circular-aperture RPAA with a large number ( 382 el.) of single-bit reradiating elements has been modeled. It is shown that a sufficiently high beam-pointing accuracy can be achieved at a reasonable cost.

articleTitle: Influence of structural defects on electric current in the channel of MOS-transistor
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of structural imperfections on the basic parameters of the I-V characteristic of MOS-transistors has been found out with aid of modern research methods. 1) silicon's subsurface layers consist of strong breaking silicon, which has some dielectric properties, and silicon crystal layers with dislocation's nets and finished within the limits of layers of silicon. 2) oxygen reveals electrical activity and influences the parameters of structural defects that, in turn, affect the charge carrier mobility

articleTitle: The nonlocal electron transport in transistor structures with submicron surface relief
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: For a field effect transistor with its gate placed in submicron recess, the parameters of nonlocal electron heating were investigated as function of the recess depth and the gate position. It is shown that the recessing can really change the properties of electron transport. Even in structures without gate and with 1.5 /spl mu/m recess maximum drift velocity is about one and half time greater than the steady-state drift velocity in strong field. The recess leads to changes in device drift velocity and electric field distributions, so the static domain displaced from the gate not to the drain contact but to the drain edge of recess when the gate is open without changing its shape.

articleTitle: Second transformation units of monoimpulse receiver

articleTitle: Physically feasible capacity of communication channel

articleTitle: Investigation of the system with coupled open cylindrical resonators in the millimeter wave-band

articleTitle: On the issue of operating mode optimization in a TWT three-electrode gun
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: 3-D simulation of cooker magnetron with cold secondary emission cathode
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results from a 3-D simulation of dynamics and formation of an electron cloud in an cooker SEC magnetron when it is triggered off at a sag of an anode voltage pulse having a special shape are presented.

articleTitle: Nonthermal millimeter electromagnetic field effect on the marine luminous bacteria
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The nonthermal intensity millimeter electromagnetic field effect on the marine luminous bacteria are presented. The unique ability of luminous bacteria to emit light provides an opportunity for study of effects induced by electromagnetic fields. Therefore, the peculiarities of effects induced by electromagnetic radiation of the millimeter wavelengths and nonthermal intensity on the marine luminous bacteria Photobacterium leiognathi, strain 54 were studied. The results can be used for medical and ecological applications.

articleTitle: Estimation of dielectric parameters of biological materials behind reflection coefficient
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Resonator spectrometer for 36-360 GHz frequency band: results of investigations of dielectrics with ultra low absorption
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The uniform set of radiation sources in the frequency range 36-360 GHz on the base of BWO, with the frequency step=0.3 Hz were created. The sources are used in the resonator spectrometer for exciting the measuring resonator and for precise recording of its resonance curve. The dielectric absorption mechanism of modern CVD-diamonds and monocrystal silicon at the frequencies 45-360 GHz and temperature interval 20-650 C was investigated. articleTitle: History of mm-therapy. Biophysical mechanisms (evolution of opinions)
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Appearance, successful development and wide application of EHF-therapy in Russian medicine are caused by achievements in microwave electronics, biophysical experiments, clinical approbation and medical practice. In particular, these achievements have been considered in chronological order with references to scientific publications in the first part of the present paper. The second part describes recent achievements in explanation of biophysical mechanisms of low-intensive mm-waves influence on biological objects.

articleTitle: Biological perception of physical signals of nonthermal intensities
publicationTitle: 2005 15th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: GDV-camera has been used in the present study for non-invasive monitoring of various biological reactions. The device enables to capture images of human fingertips' emission, the latter being induced by electromagnetic field (intensity 1.7 KV, frequency 1000 Hz, impulses' duration-10 musec). Systemic alterations that occur in human organisms in response to short-term local signals of low intensities have been investigated. Specific and non-specific biological effects were revealed while analyzing induced emission of fingertips. It is concluded that physical signals of non-thermal intensities are perceived and processed by the organism in a systematic manner. Specific and non-specific two-phased biological responses have been revealed while investigating short-term magnetic and electromagnetic signals of low intensities
